newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasuries flat to higher ahead of payrolls.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasuries flat to higher ahead of payrolls.

text.p: U.S. Treasury securities prices were flat to slightly higher Friday morning ahead of the July nonfarm payrolls report.

Economists surveyed by Reuters expected, on average, that 193,000 new jobs would have been created in the month, down from the 217,000 figure seen in the prior month. The unemployment rate also was seen dropping to 4.9 percent from the 5.0 percent level seen in June, analysts said.
Personal income and consumption numbers for June also were due with economists expecting a slight gain of 0.4 percent from May's 0.3 percent rise.
